About AS Textile

Built around quality, consistency, and dependable supply.

AS Textile is based in Karachi, Pakistan, specializing in export-class textile products and bulk-quantity orders. We are currently open to new orders and welcome new contracts with quality-focused clients.

From careful material selection to final inspection, our production is shaped for buyers who need reliable quality at commercial scale.

Quality First

Careful inspection throughout production and before dispatch.

Bulk Capability

Production planned for consistent, large-quantity requirements.

Flexible Supply

Product specifications tailored for hospitality, retail, and trade.

Export Mindset

Clear communication and buyer-focused production standards.
